etiquette: robots.txt disallows /_next/static/ for crawlers. Nothing was fetched outside normal page loads: scripts were read from the browser's own Debugger sources, source maps were not fetched (--fetch-source-maps not used). Six page loads in total across all targets.

monospace display headings for developer sections

code panel with macOS dots and language tabs (Python / JavaScript / cURL) and line numbers
saturated colour-block step cards (amber, violet) joined by hand-drawn arrows

buildathon.stack: separate Vite + React + Tailwind app (assets from buildathon.bolna-ai.lovable.app) served under /symphony/buildathon; REA vendor fingerprint: React; 5 first-party scripts (main 341 KB)
buildathon.hero_build: static 1920x1080 JPEG of concentric green arcs as an object-cover background (not canvas/WebGL); title is a PNG wordmark in pixelated serif lettering inside the h1 with alt text; glass pill (black 55%, backdrop blur xl, saturate 150%, soft drop shadow + 1 px inset top highlight at 6% white) holding the YC x Symphony marks; orange-outlined chip 'Path to YC'; meta row with green line icons; gradient green pill CTA

drives: step circles switch to filled green with 700 ms ease-out CSS transitions
a muted background MP4 scrubbed by setting currentTime = p x duration, radial-masked at 10% opacity

buildathon.cards: prize cards with the arc artwork as background, outlined numerals, orange 'Grand prize' pill
buildathon.hover: icon tiles get an animate-ping halo on hover
buildathon.performance_observed: light JS; 2 Space Grotesk woff2; 2 MP4 (one autoplay loop, one scrubbed with preload=auto: heavy on mobile data); ~20 images

techniques_for_ruko_in_its_own_way: Keep Ruko's own SVG Arcs as the Symphony nod, but make them live: driven by the call's audio level (Bolna's own buildathon arcs are a static JPEG/video).
Generate a halftone texture in CSS (radial-gradient dot pattern with mask-image) instead of shipping PNGs.
Use Fragment Mono uppercase eyebrow chips with 0.18em tracking for 'developer' labels (Bolna's mono-chip language), keep Open Runde/Inter for prose.
Use a dark 'stage' band (near-black with a horizon rim glow) for the live call section inside the warm light obliqq-style page.
Build 'How Ruko decides' as a pinned sticky sequence with motion useScroll: progress line, steps lighting up at thresholds, Arcs/waveform scrubbed instead of a video.
Add a tabbed code panel (cURL / JS / Python) for the bank integration with a layoutId tab indicator.
Use one pixel-type word (Ruko already ships Silkscreen/PixelWord) as a nod to the BUILDATHON wordmark; do not reuse their PNGs or the YC/Symphony marks beyond factual mentions.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion everywhere (Bolna's pages don't; Ruko's kit already does).
